```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(data.table)
  library(ComplexHeatmap)
  library(circlize)
  library(grid)
})
set.seed(42)
graphics.off()
```

# Layout

One gene, all tumors with at least one assay as columns. Rows are grouped by VAF cutoff:
first the VAF >= 3% block, then the VAF >= 5% block. Within each block: IMPACT, WES, WGS and
Combined (which assays detected the gene).

- IMPACT, WES and WGS rows: coloured by variant class; the number in a cell is the VAF (%).
  Multi_Hit = more than one variant in the gene in that assay.
- Combined row: coloured by the assays that detected the gene; the number is the highest VAF.
- White = not sequenced by that assay; grey = sequenced, no call.
- Right: stacked bars of mutated tumors per row and % mutated (of tumors sequenced by that assay;
  Combined: of all tumors). Top: highest FOXA1 VAF per tumor (any assay, lowest cutoff).
- Bottom: sequencing strips and the clinical annotation used in the oncoplots.

```{r paths_and_parameters}

wgs_audit     <- "/ix1/alee/LO_LAB/Personal/Rahul/pILC/WGS/PCGR/Downstream/Variant_classification/Top_Mutated_Genes_Cohort/Full_MAF_nonsilent_variant_PCGR_VAF_match_audit_2026-09-29.tsv"
```

```{r helpers}
std_id <- function(x) {
  x <- toupper(trimws(as.character(x)))
  x <- sub("^JC287-", "", x)
  x <- sub("(_T|-T|\\.T)$", "", x)
  x <- sub("(?<=[0-9])T$", "", x, perl = TRUE)
  sub("-0+(?=[0-9])", "-", x, perl = TRUE)     # TP09-09 = TP09-9
}
natural_sample_order <- function(s) {
  s <- unique(as.character(s))
  tp <- suppressWarnings(as.integer(sub("^TP([0-9]+).*", "\\1", s))); tp[is.na(tp)] <- 9999L
  rest <- suppressWarnings(as.integer(gsub("[^0-9]", "", sub("^TP[0-9]+[-_]*", "", s)))); rest[is.na(rest)] <- 9999L
  s[order(tp, rest, s)]
}
save_plot <- function(file_base, width, height, draw_fn, res = 300) {
  pdf(paste0(file_base, ".pdf"), width = width, height = height); draw_fn(); dev.off()
  png(paste0(file_base, ".png"), width = width, height = height, units = "in", res = res); draw_fn(); dev.off()
  cat("Saved:", paste0(file_base, c(".pdf", ".png")), sep = "\n  "); cat("\n")
}
parse_percent_value <- function(x) {
  x <- trimws(as.character(x)); x[x %in% c("", "NA", "N/A", "NaN", "nan")] <- NA_character_
  lt <- grepl("^<", x)
  v <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(gsub("[^0-9.]", "", x)))
  v[lt & !is.na(v)] <- v[lt & !is.na(v)] / 2
  v
}
clean_receptor_status <- function(x) {
  x <- gsub("\\s+", " ", trimws(as.character(x)))
  out <- rep("Unknown", length(x))
  out[grepl("^Positive", x, ignore.case = TRUE)] <- "Positive"
  out[grepl("^Negative", x, ignore.case = TRUE)] <- "Negative"
  out
}
clean_grade_status <- function(x) {
  x <- gsub("\\s+", " ", trimws(as.character(x)))
  x[x %in% c("", "NA", "N/A", "NaN", "nan") | is.na(x)] <- "Unknown"
  x
}
```

```{r read_calls}
min_thr <- min(VAF_THRESHOLDS)
universe <- list()

imp <- fread(impact_file, sep = "\t", na.strings = c("", "NA"))
imp[, Tumor := std_id(TUMOR_SAMPLE)]
universe$IMPACT <- unique(imp$Tumor)
ci <- imp[toupper(SYMBOL) == GENE & Variant_Classification %in% nonsilent_classes & !is.na(TUMOR_MAF),
          .(Assay = "IMPACT", Tumor, Class = Variant_Classification, VAF = as.numeric(TUMOR_MAF))]
rm(imp)

wes <- fread(wes_audit, sep = "\t", na.strings = c("", "NA", "."),
             select = c("Hugo_Symbol", "Tumor_Sample_Barcode", "Variant_Classification", "VAF_TUMOR_fraction"))
wes[, Tumor := std_id(Tumor_Sample_Barcode)]
universe$WES <- unique(wes$Tumor)
cw <- wes[toupper(Hugo_Symbol) == GENE & Variant_Classification %in% nonsilent_classes & !is.na(VAF_TUMOR_fraction),
          .(Assay = "WES", Tumor, Class = Variant_Classification, VAF = as.numeric(VAF_TUMOR_fraction))]
rm(wes)

wgs <- fread(wgs_audit, sep = "\t", na.strings = c("", "NA"),
             select = c("Sample_key", "Hugo_Symbol", "Variant_Classification", "VAF_TUMOR_fraction", "matched", "is_nonsilent"))
wgs[, Tumor := std_id(Sample_key)]
universe$WGS <- union(unique(wgs$Tumor), std_id(list.dirs(wgs_pcgr_dir, recursive = FALSE, full.names = FALSE)))
cg <- wgs[toupper(Hugo_Symbol) == GENE & as.logical(is_nonsilent) & !is.na(VAF_TUMOR_fraction),
          .(Assay = "WGS", Tumor, Class = Variant_Classification, VAF = as.numeric(VAF_TUMOR_fraction))]
rm(wgs)

calls <- rbind(ci, cw, cg)
tumors <- natural_sample_order(unique(unlist(universe)))
cat("Tumors in total:", length(tumors), "\n"); print(sapply(universe, length))
cat(GENE, "non-silent calls at VAF >=", min_thr * 100, "% by assay:\n")
print(calls[VAF >= min_thr, .(tumors = uniqueN(Tumor), variants = .N), by = Assay])
```

```{r clinical}
clin <- fread(clinical_file, sep = ",", header = TRUE, data.table = TRUE, fill = TRUE,
              na.strings = c("", "NA", "NaN", "N/A"))
clin[, Tumor := std_id(Sample)]
clin <- unique(clin[, .(Tumor,
  tumor_cellularity_pct = parse_percent_value(`tumor_cellularity (%)`),
  pleomorphic_pct = parse_percent_value(`pleomorphic_invasive_compoent_cellularity (%)`),
  TILs_pct = parse_percent_value(`TILs (%)`),
  Grade = clean_grade_status(`Grade/Differentiation-Desc`),
  HER2 = clean_receptor_status(`BREAST: Her-2/Neu-Desc`),
  ER = clean_receptor_status(`Tumor Marker #1 (ER)`),
  PR = clean_receptor_status(`Tumor Marker #2 (PR)`))], by = "Tumor")
clin <- clin[match(tumors, Tumor)]
cat("Tumors matched to the clinical file:", sum(tumors %in% clin$Tumor), "of", length(tumors), "\n")
```

```{r build_matrix}
class_cols <- c(
  "Missense_Mutation" = "#1F77B4", "Nonsense_Mutation" = "#D62728", "Frame_Shift_Del" = "#9467BD",
  "Frame_Shift_Ins" = "#8C564B", "In_Frame_Del" = "#2CA02C", "In_Frame_Ins" = "#17BECF",
  "Splice_Site" = "#FF7F0E", "Splice_Region" = "#FFBB78", "Translation_Start_Site" = "#E377C2",
  "Nonstop_Mutation" = "#BCBD22", "Multi_Hit" = "#000000"
)
combo_cols <- c(
  "IMPACT" = "#E26A8A", "IMPACT+WES" = "#C58B00", "IMPACT+WES+WGS" = "#7BA000",
  "IMPACT+WGS" = "#00A86B", "WES" = "#00A9C5", "WES+WGS" = "#7F8FE0", "WGS" = "#D166D1"
)
state_cols <- c("None" = "grey92", "Not sequenced" = "white")
all_cols <- c(class_cols, combo_cols, state_cols)

blank_row <- function(fill) setNames(rep(fill, length(tumors)), tumors)

rows <- list(); vtxt <- list(); row_lab <- character(); row_blk <- character(); row_den <- integer()
cell_low <- NULL

for (thr in VAF_THRESHOLDS) {
  blk <- sprintf("VAF \u2265 %d%%", as.integer(round(100 * thr)))
  cell <- calls[VAF >= thr, .(Class = if (.N > 1) "Multi_Hit" else Class[1], MaxVAF = max(VAF)), by = .(Assay, Tumor)]
  if (is.null(cell_low)) cell_low <- cell

  for (a in mods) {
    r <- blank_row("None"); v <- blank_row("")
    d <- cell[Assay == a]
    r[d$Tumor] <- d$Class; v[d$Tumor] <- sprintf("%.0f", 100 * d$MaxVAF)
    r[!(tumors %in% universe[[a]])] <- "Not sequenced"
    rows[[length(rows) + 1]] <- r; vtxt[[length(vtxt) + 1]] <- v
    row_lab <- c(row_lab, a); row_blk <- c(row_blk, blk); row_den <- c(row_den, length(universe[[a]]))
  }
  r <- blank_row("None"); v <- blank_row("")
  comb <- cell[, .(Combo = paste(mods[mods %in% Assay], collapse = "+"), MaxVAF = max(MaxVAF)), by = Tumor]
  r[comb$Tumor] <- comb$Combo; v[comb$Tumor] <- sprintf("%.0f", 100 * comb$MaxVAF)
  rows[[length(rows) + 1]] <- r; vtxt[[length(vtxt) + 1]] <- v
  row_lab <- c(row_lab, "Combined"); row_blk <- c(row_blk, blk); row_den <- c(row_den, length(tumors))
}

mat <- do.call(rbind, rows); vaf_mat <- do.call(rbind, vtxt)
rownames(mat) <- rownames(vaf_mat) <- paste(row_blk, row_lab, sep = " | ")
fwrite(data.table(Row = rownames(mat), mat), file.path(out_dir, paste0(GENE, "_oncoplot_matrix.tsv")), sep = "\t")

cats <- setdiff(unique(as.vector(mat)), c("None", "Not sequenced"))
bar_mat <- do.call(cbind, lapply(cats, function(cn) rowSums(mat == cn)))
colnames(bar_mat) <- cats; rownames(bar_mat) <- rownames(mat)
pct <- paste0(round(100 * rowSums(mat != "None" & mat != "Not sequenced") / row_den), "%")
print(data.table(Row = rownames(mat), Mutated = rowSums(mat != "None" & mat != "Not sequenced"),
                 Denominator = row_den, Percent = pct))
```

```{r draw}
# ---- annotations ----
top_v <- setNames(rep(0, length(tumors)), tumors)
top_v[cell_low[, .(v = max(MaxVAF)), by = Tumor]$Tumor] <- 100 * cell_low[, .(v = max(MaxVAF)), by = Tumor]$v
top_ha <- HeatmapAnnotation(
  `Max VAF (%)` = anno_barplot(top_v, gp = gpar(fill = "grey45", col = NA), border = FALSE, bar_width = 0.85,
                               height = unit(2, "cm"), axis_param = list(gp = gpar(fontsize = 7))),
  annotation_name_gp = gpar(fontsize = 8), annotation_name_side = "left"
)

right_ha <- rowAnnotation(
  `Mutated tumors` = anno_barplot(bar_mat, gp = gpar(fill = all_cols[colnames(bar_mat)], col = NA),
                                  border = FALSE, bar_width = 0.85, axis_param = list(gp = gpar(fontsize = 7), side = "bottom")),
  `% mutated` = anno_text(pct, gp = gpar(fontsize = 8), just = "left", location = 0),
  width = unit(3.6, "cm"), show_annotation_name = FALSE
)

grade_cols <- c("Grade I" = "#A6CEE3", "Grade II" = "#33A02C", "Grade III" = "#1F78B4",
                "Cell type not determined" = "#E31A1C", "Unknown" = "#BDBDBD")
rec_cols <- c("Negative" = "#1F78B4", "Positive" = "#E31A1C", "Unknown" = "#BDBDBD")
seq_cols <- c("Sequenced" = "black", "Not sequenced" = "grey85")
extra_g <- setdiff(unique(na.omit(clin$Grade)), names(grade_cols))
if (length(extra_g)) { eg <- hcl.colors(length(extra_g), "Dark 3"); names(eg) <- extra_g; grade_cols <- c(grade_cols, eg) }

anno_df <- data.frame(
  `IMPACT seq.` = ifelse(tumors %in% universe$IMPACT, "Sequenced", "Not sequenced"),
  `WES seq.`    = ifelse(tumors %in% universe$WES,    "Sequenced", "Not sequenced"),
  `WGS seq.`    = ifelse(tumors %in% universe$WGS,    "Sequenced", "Not sequenced"),
  `Tumor cell. (%)` = clin$tumor_cellularity_pct, `Pleomorphic (%)` = clin$pleomorphic_pct,
  `TILs (%)` = clin$TILs_pct, Grade = clin$Grade, HER2 = clin$HER2, ER = clin$ER, PR = clin$PR,
  check.names = FALSE, row.names = tumors
)
bottom_ha <- HeatmapAnnotation(
  df = anno_df,
  col = list(`IMPACT seq.` = seq_cols, `WES seq.` = seq_cols, `WGS seq.` = seq_cols,
             `Tumor cell. (%)` = colorRamp2(c(0, 50, 100), c("#F7FBFF", "#6BAED6", "#08306B")),
             `Pleomorphic (%)` = colorRamp2(c(0, 50, 100), c("#F7FCF5", "#74C476", "#00441B")),
             `TILs (%)` = colorRamp2(c(0, 30, 100), c("#FFF5F0", "#FB6A4A", "#67000D")),
             Grade = grade_cols, HER2 = rec_cols, ER = rec_cols, PR = rec_cols),
  na_col = "grey90", annotation_name_side = "left", annotation_name_gp = gpar(fontsize = 8),
  simple_anno_size = unit(0.32, "cm"), gap = unit(1, "mm"), border = TRUE
)

# ---- legends for the main matrix ----
used_class <- intersect(names(class_cols), unique(as.vector(mat)))
used_combo <- intersect(names(combo_cols), unique(as.vector(mat)))
lgd_class <- Legend(title = "Variant class (assay rows)", at = used_class, legend_gp = gpar(fill = class_cols[used_class]),
                    labels_gp = gpar(fontsize = 8), title_gp = gpar(fontsize = 9, fontface = "bold"))
lgd_combo <- Legend(title = "Assays detecting (Combined rows)", at = used_combo, legend_gp = gpar(fill = combo_cols[used_combo]),
                    labels_gp = gpar(fontsize = 8), title_gp = gpar(fontsize = 9, fontface = "bold"))
lgd_state <- Legend(title = "Cell state", at = c("Sequenced, no call", "Not sequenced"),
                    legend_gp = gpar(fill = c("grey92", "white"), col = "grey60"),
                    labels_gp = gpar(fontsize = 8), title_gp = gpar(fontsize = 9, fontface = "bold"))

ht <- Heatmap(
  mat, name = GENE, col = all_cols,
  cluster_rows = FALSE, cluster_columns = FALSE,
  row_split = factor(row_blk, levels = unique(row_blk)), row_gap = unit(3, "mm"),
  row_labels = row_lab, row_names_side = "left", row_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 9),
  row_title_gp = gpar(fontsize = 10, fontface = "bold"),
  show_column_names = TRUE, column_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 7),
  rect_gp = gpar(col = "white", lwd = 0.6),
  width = unit(CELL_W_MM * length(tumors), "mm"), height = unit(CELL_H_MM * nrow(mat), "mm"),
  top_annotation = top_ha, bottom_annotation = bottom_ha, right_annotation = right_ha,
  column_title = paste0(GENE, " mutation status by assay (", length(tumors), " tumors)"),
  column_title_gp = gpar(fontsize = 11, fontface = "bold"),
  layer_fun = function(j, i, x, y, w, h, fill) {
    txt <- pindex(vaf_mat, i, j)
    ok <- txt != ""
    if (any(ok)) grid.text(txt[ok], x[ok], y[ok], gp = gpar(fontsize = 5.5, col = "white", fontface = "bold"))
  },
  show_heatmap_legend = FALSE
)

draw_fig <- function() {
  draw(ht, heatmap_legend_list = list(lgd_class, lgd_combo, lgd_state),
       heatmap_legend_side = "right", annotation_legend_side = "right", merge_legends = FALSE,
       padding = unit(c(4, 4, 4, 8), "mm"))
}
# Page size = heatmap body + left labels (row titles, row names, annotation names, ~70 mm)
# + right panel (bars and % text, ~45 mm) + legends (~135 mm) + margins.
fig_w <- (CELL_W_MM * length(tumors) + 70 + 45 + 135 + 10) / 25.4
fig_h <- (CELL_H_MM * nrow(mat) + 20 + 22 + 45 + 15) / 25.4
save_plot(file.path(out_dir, paste0(GENE, "_oncoplot_by_assay")), width = max(fig_w, 15), height = max(fig_h, 7), draw_fn = draw_fig)
```
